Shorts programmes recorded via shorts_program: the five 5@5 programmes, The Barber, the Brush and the Baton, Our New Frontier: Sustainability, and the Youth Reel; Hip Hop Maestro (41 min) counted as short because it is in a shorts programme. Youth Reel titles (beyond Ndapewa and Alone, named in the note) come only from the title index; no directors, countries or runtimes printed. A further CFI My Place, My Story film in the Youth Reel is described but not named. Hi De Ho Show (John Goddard's jazz clip evening, listed among film notes under US Cinema) recorded as a music event, not a film. The grid shows Play Like a Lion at 142 Throckmorton on Friday Oct 14, 7:30 PM (AKBR14T) and 'Play Like a Lion (Live)' on Sat Oct 15 with the same code; the concert page gives Sat Oct 15, 7:30 PM (AKBR15T), so the Oct 14 grid cell was treated as a misplacement and not added as a film screening. Grid lists One Through Love at 120 mins (note says 59 mins, programme includes a live web dialogue); runtime kept at 59. Grid slots marked TBA not recorded.
